notes: τῶν before ἀπό is left unrepresented because of answers to ἀπό and the to τῆς; rule 31's closing clause makes an unrepresented article right in front of a prepositional phrase exactly where the ASV supplies no relative clause, which is this case, and rule 21 forbids leaving a bare of on it.
Recitative ὅτι is unrepresented under rule 43, λέγοντες already carrying its own word.
